title: Fei Zhi Baike

synonyms: Fei Zhi Baike: Yuanlai Ni Shi Zheyang de Zhiwu

synopsis:
This is an animated series that presents a wide range of knowledge—spanning the natural world and human culture—through a charming and adorable style, offering viewers a lighthearted and delightful educational experience. The series currently covers diverse topics such as plants, clothing, animals, corporations, animation, cuisine, and professions, with even more surprising and entertaining facts on the way.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
